findings.reason: The cited alarms confirm the failure and outage, but the topology evidence proving the shared link dependency is not cited.
Both topology references explicitly list LNK-SFX-02-A as the parent link for both sites.
The alarm record explicitly states a critical LINK_LOS on LNK-SFX-02-A raised at 02:13.
Both alarm records show SITE_DOWN raised at 02:14, one minute after the link alarm.
The tool output explicitly reports no changes on the specified nodes and parents in the window.
The tool output explicitly reports no maintenance windows on the specified nodes and parents.
T7 shows availability dropping to 0 and recovering at 08:45, matching the claim.
